issues.title: Feature: Tabbed TUI with Plan Browser
issues.body:
## Goal

Modify the pib TUI so that in addition to kicking off a new planner, it can also display existing plans and their status.

### In scope
- Read-only two-pane plan browser
- Plan metadata and issue-count aggregation
- Issue status preview (derived state, blockers, acceptance)
- Tab switching and drill-down navigation
- Responsive pane sizing

### Out of scope
- Launching agents from the TUI
- Editing issues or plans
- Creating new plans from the browser
- Additional tabs beyond Plan and Plans
acceptance: Tab bar renders above all content with Plan and Plans tabs
Plan tab preserves existing textarea prompt behavior
Plans tab shows two-pane plan list with metadata and issue counts
Arrow keys navigate plan list; right/enter opens plan detail
Plan detail shows two-pane issue list with status preview
Left/esc returns from plan detail to plan list
All data loads asynchronously; UI never blocks on SQLite

issues.title: ADR: Tabbed TUI Architecture for Plan Browser
issues.body:
## Task

Document architecture decisions for the tabbed TUI.

Produce `docs/adrs/00X-tabbed-tui-plan-browser.md` covering:

- Tab state model and sub-view transitions
- Async loading patterns for Bubble Tea
- Two-pane layout algorithm and responsive sizing
- Keybinding conventions (tabs, navigation, drill-down)

### ADRs
- docs/adrs/00X-tabbed-tui-plan-browser.md

### Domain Terms
- **Tab** — Top-level navigation category
- **Plan List View** — First sub-view of Plans tab
- **Plan Detail View** — Second sub-view of Plans tab
acceptance: Covers tab state model and sub-view transitions
Defines two-pane layout and responsive sizing

issues.title: Task: Add Tab Framework and Refactor Prompt into TabPlan
issues.body:
## Task

Introduce tabbed navigation to the TUI.

Modify `internal/ui/model.go` and related files to support multiple tabs.

- Add `tab` enum (`tabPlan`, `tabPlans`) and `currentTab` field to `Model`
- Store `config` in `Model` for `AgentFor` lookups
- `Update` dispatches by tab; `View` renders tab bar + active tab content
- Move existing prompt code into `tabPlan` handlers
- Tab switching via `1`/`2` keys and `tab` key
- Tab bar styled with active/inactive states using Lipgloss
- Startup phases remain unchanged; `phasePrompt` becomes `tabPlan`

### ADRs
- docs/adrs/00X-tabbed-tui-plan-browser.md

### Domain Terms
- **tabPlan** — Tab containing the original planner prompt
- **tabPlans** — Tab containing the plan browser
acceptance: Tab enum and currentTab field exist in Model
Prompt refactored into tabPlan without behavior change
Tab bar renders with active/inactive styling

issues.title: Task: Implement Plan List Tab with Two-Pane Browse
issues.body:
## Task

Build the two-pane plan browser.

Implement `tabPlans` plan list view in `internal/ui/`.

- Left pane: scrollable plan list from `store.Plans()` (async command)
- Right pane: selected plan metadata (title, slug, created_at) + aggregated issue counts
- Arrow keys (`↑`/`↓`) move cursor through plan list
- `→` or `enter` opens plan detail view for selected plan
- Empty state renders when no plans exist
- Error state renders if store query fails
- Pane widths responsive to terminal size (left ~35%, right ~65%)
- Loading indicator shown while data fetches

### ADRs
- docs/adrs/00X-tabbed-tui-plan-browser.md

### Domain Terms
- **Plan List View** — First sub-view of Plans tab
- **Plan metadata** — Slug, title, created date, issue counts
acceptance: Plan list loads asynchronously from store
Left pane shows scrollable plan list
Right pane shows metadata and issue counts for selected plan

issues.title: Task: Implement Plan Detail Drill-Down View
issues.body:
## Task

Build the two-pane issue drill-down.

Implement plan detail sub-view within `tabPlans`.

- Left pane: issue list for selected plan (from `store.Statuses`)
- Right pane: issue status preview (state, derived flags: blocked, ready, in-progress, awaiting-review)
- Preview includes blockers, acceptance criteria, timestamps, agent mapping
- Arrow keys (`↑`/`↓`) navigate issue list
- `←` or `esc` returns to plan list view
- Empty state when plan has no issues
- Error state handled
- Async loading; UI never blocks

### ADRs
- docs/adrs/00X-tabbed-tui-plan-browser.md

### Domain Terms
- **Plan Detail View** — Second sub-view of Plans tab
- **Issue status preview** — Derived state plus blockers/acceptance
acceptance: Issue list loads asynchronously for selected plan
Left pane shows scrollable issue list
Right pane shows full status preview

issues.title: Task: Polish, Edge Cases, and Tests
issues.body:
## Task

Harden the tabbed TUI.

Handle edge cases and add tests for all new UI logic.

- Narrow terminal fallback: single-pane when width < 80
- Long titles truncated with ellipsis in lists
- Loading spinner/indicator during async fetches
- Unit tests for tab switching, cursor navigation, sub-view transitions
- Existing tests updated for new Model fields
- Window resize handled correctly in all views
- Tab bar does not steal focus from active pane

### ADRs
- docs/adrs/00X-tabbed-tui-plan-browser.md

### Domain Terms
- **Tabbed TUI** — The new multi-tab terminal interface
acceptance: Loading states visible during async fetches

issues.body:
